name: metrics_link
description: Input link metrics of one consumer tile instance, one row per link per sweep

sample_id.description: Identifier shared by every row of one sweep

sample_slot.description: Slot that triggered the sweep, 0 for periodic sweeps

sample_snapct_state.description: Snapshot load state entered, for snapct_state sweeps; unknown otherwise

sample_caught_up.description: Whether replay had caught up to the cluster tip when the sweep was taken (replay IsCaughtUp); set once per run, never cleared

sample_tile_cnt.description: Tile instances in the sweep, to detect partial sweeps

kind_id.description: Index of this tile instance among tiles of its kind

link_idx.description: Index of the input link on the consumer tile

frag_consumed.description: Fragments consumed by the link reader

frag_consumed_bytes.description: Bytes read by the link consumer

frag_filtered_bytes.description: Bytes read by the link consumer that were filtered

link_polling_overrun.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Times the link was overrun while polling

frag_polling_overrun.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Fragments not processed because the link was overrun while polling

link_reading_overrun.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Times the link was overrun while reading metadata

frag_reading_overrun.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Fragments not processed because the link was overrun while reading

backpressure_blamed.description: Producer housekeeping intervals in which the producer was backpressured and this reliable consumer had the least credit across its outs; sampled, not an event count
